data.raw_text:
The Hyderabad Traffic Police on Tuesday issued a comprehensive traffic advisory for the night of December 31, 2025, in view of New Year celebrations across the city.

As part of the arrangements, traffic personnel will be deployed at 217 key junctions and busy intersections to ensure smooth flow and road safety, with special focus on crowded areas such as Tank Bund, NTR Marg, PVNR Marg (Necklace Road), malls, markets, pubs and commercial zones in Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, Punjagutta, Khairatabad and surrounding localities.

Need-based traffic restrictions will be imposed from 11 pm onwards on Tank Bund and its surrounding areas. Traffic will be completely prohibited on NTR Marg, PVNR Marg (Necklace Road) and Tank Bund between 11 pm and 2 am on the intervening night of December 31 and January 1. Several diversions will be enforced around Hussain Sagar to regulate vehicular movement.
